question: How long can a drinking straw be?
answer: You never pull a drink up a straw. You lower the pressure in your mouth and the outside air pushes the liquid up, and air gives up at 10.3 m, so a longer straw does not work. A 116 m tree drinks because it pulls the water instead.
move: A straw only lets the air push, and the air gives up at 10.3 m. Trees pull.
